name: 股吧帖子爬取
description: 爬取一篇股吧帖子的正文（标题+内容，最多8000字符）。无需登录。

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: 股吧帖子链接（guba.eastmoney.com/news,代码,帖子id.html）；不填则在当前标签页爬取

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const target=want('$url');const isArt=()=>/guba\.eastmoney\.com\/news,/.test(location.href);if(target&&location.href!==target&&!isArt()){location.href=target;const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&!isArt())await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));}if(!isArt())return {ok:false,error:'not-post-page',hint:'请传入股吧帖子链接（guba.eastmoney.com/news,代码,帖子id.html）'};await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));const body=document.querySelector('#newscontent')||document.querySelector('.newspage');if(!body)return {ok:false,error:'no-content',hint:'正文未渲染或帖子已被删除'};const t=document.querySelector('.news_title')||document.querySelector('h1');const postTime=(document.body.innerText.match(/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}/)||[''])[0];const replyM=(document.body.innerText.match(/(?:全部回复|共\s*)(\d+)\s*(?:条|条回复|回复)/)||[]);return {ok:true,title:((t?t.textContent.trim():'')||document.title.split('_')[0].trim()),postTime:postTime||null,replies:replyM?parseInt(replyM[1]):null,content:body.innerText.replace(/\s+\n/g,'\n').trim().slice(0,8000),url:location.href};})()

body.note: 提取正文 + 发帖时间 + 回复数（页面可见数字，尽力而为）
